Hi there, I'm Emma!

Whenever I'm not pretending to be an elite runner, I am a PhD student at the UCL Econ Department - which mostly means running regressions instead of marathons. Check out my [research](/research/) or my [CV](/cv.html), and feel free to get in touch via email.

My paper *Less to Lose: How shorter and more flexible degrees reshaped university choice and earnings* won the **2026 UniCredit Foundation Best Paper Award in Education Economics**. [Paper](/papers/BP_Portugal_Scandolo.pdf) · [Slides](/papers/BP_Portugal_Scandolo_Slides.pdf)
